arxiv-1608-05491.title: Point mass Cosmological Black Holes
arxiv-1608-05491.creator: Javad T. Firouzjaee, Touhid Feghhi
arxiv-1608-05491.description: Abstract Abstract: Real black holes in the universe are located in the expanding accelerating background which are called the cosmological black holes. Hence, it is necessary to model these black holes in the cosmological background where the dark energy is the dominant energy.

arxiv-2012-03833.title: What Meaning-Form Correlation Has to Compose With: A Study of Mfc on Artificial and Natural Language
arxiv-2012-03833.creator: Timothee Mickus, Timothée Bernard, Denis Paperno
arxiv-2012-03833.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Timothee Mickus, Timothée Bernard, Denis Paperno. Compositionality is a widely discussed property of natural languages, although its exact definition has been elusive. We focus on the proposal that compositionality can be assessed by measuring meaning-form correlation. We analyze meaning-form correlation on three sets of languages: (i) artificial toy languages tailored to be compositional, (ii) a set of English dictionary definitions, and (iii) a set of English sentences drawn from literature.

arxiv-2112-03818.title: The Spectroscopic Binaries from LAMOST Medium-Resolution Survey (MRS). I. Searching for Double-lined Spectroscopic Binaries (SB2s) with Convolutional Neural Network Journal: ApJS Facilities: LAMOST berliner ( Zhang 2020a ) , laspec ( Zhang 2020b ) , astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ) , sc
arxiv-2112-03818.creator: Bo Zhang, Ying-Jie Jing, Fan Yang, Jun-Chen Wan, Xin Ji, Jian-Ning Fu, Chao Liu, Xiao-Bin Zhang, Feng Luo, Hao Tian, Yu-Tao Zhou, Jia-Xin Wang, Yan-Jun Guo, Weikai Zong, Jian-Ping Xiong, Jiao Li
arxiv-2112-03818.description: Abstract We developed a convolutional neural network (CNN) model to distinguish the double-lined spectroscopic binaries (SB2s) from others based on single exposure medium-resolution spectra ( R ∼ 7,500 R\sim 7,500 ). The training set consists of a large set of mock spectra of single stars and binaries synthesized based on the MIST stellar evolutionary model and ATLAS9 atmospheric model.

arxiv-2112-05045.title: Multi-Kink Quantile Regression for Longitudinal Data with Application to the Progesterone Data Analysis
arxiv-2112-05045.creator: Chuang Wan, Wei Zhong, Wenyang Zhang and Changliang Zou
arxiv-2112-05045.description: Abstract Motivated by investigating the relationship between progesterone and the days in a menstrual cycle in a longitudinal study, we propose a multi-kink quantile regression model for longitudinal data analysis. It relaxes the linearity condition and assumes different regression forms in different regions of the domain of the threshold covariate.

arxiv-2208-10470.title: Variational quantum iterative power algorithms for global optimization
arxiv-2208-10470.creator: Thi Ha Kyaw, Micheline B. Soley, Brandon Allen, Paul Bergold, Chong Sun, Victor S. Batista, Alán Aspuru-Guzik
arxiv-2208-10470.description: Abstract We introduce a family of variational quantum algorithms called quantum iterative power algorithms (QIPA) that outperform existing hybrid near-term quantum algorithms of the same kind. We demonstrate the capabilities of QIPA as applied to three different global-optimization numerical experiments: the ground-state optimization of the H 2 H_{2} molecular dissociation, search of the transmon qubit ground-state, and biprime factorization.

arxiv-2208-12146.title: A Feedforward Unitary Equivariant Neural Network Journal: ???
arxiv-2208-12146.creator: Pui-Wai Ma, T.-H. Hubert Chan
arxiv-2208-12146.description: Abstract We devise a new type of feedforward neural network. It is equivariant with respect to the unitary group U ⁡ ( n ) U(n) . The input and output can be vectors in ℂ n \mathbb{C}^{n} with arbitrary dimension n n . No convolution layer is required in our implementation.

arxiv-2210-05611.title: Role of magnetic fields in the formation of direct collapse black holes
arxiv-2210-05611.creator: Muhammad A. Latif, Dominik R. G. Schleicher, Sadegh Khochfar
arxiv-2210-05611.description: Abstract Direct collapse black holes (DCBHs) are the leading candidates for the origin of the first supermassive black holes. However, the role of magnetic fields during their formation is still unclear as none of the previous studies has been evolved long enough to assess their impact during the accretion phase.

arxiv-2301-04170.title: Entanglement blossom in a simplex matryoshka Journal: Annals of Physics
arxiv-2301-04170.creator: Zhao Zhang
arxiv-2301-04170.description: Abstract Exotic entanglement entropy scaling properties usually present interesting entanglement structures in real space and novel metrics of the spacetime lattice. One prominent example is the rainbow chain where lattice sites which are symmetric about the center form entangled Bell pairs due to an effective long-range coupling in the strong inhomogeneity regime.

arxiv-2306-14666.title: Quantum squeezing cannot beat the standard quantum limit
arxiv-2306-14666.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . Quantum entanglement between particles is expected to allow one to perform tasks that would otherwise be impossible [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . In quantum sensing and metrology, entanglement is often claimed to enable a precision that cannot be attained with the same number of particles and time, forgoing entanglement [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] .

arxiv-2402-05814.title: Connectedness of level sets for non-degenerate integrable systems that extend complexity one torus actions Thanks: 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification . Primary 37J35, 53D20. Secondary 37J39, 53D35. Thanks: Keywords: Completely integrable Hamiltonian systems, non-degenerate singular points, comp
arxiv-2402-05814.creator: Daniele Sepe, Susan Tolman
arxiv-2402-05814.description: Abstract . In this paper we study the connectedness of the level sets of integrable systems that have only non-degenerate singular points and extend complexity one T T -spaces with proper moment maps. Our main result states that if there are no singular points with a hyperbolic block and connected T T -stabilizer, then each level set is connected.

arxiv-2405-01329.title: Decentralization of Ethereum’s Builder Market
arxiv-2405-01329.creator: Sen Yang, Kartik Nayak, Fan Zhang
arxiv-2405-01329.description: Abstract Blockchains protect an ecosystem worth more than $500bn with strong security properties derived from the principle of decentralization . Is today’s blockchain decentralized? In this paper, we empirically studied one of the least decentralized parts of Ethereum, its builder market. The builder market was introduced to fairly distribute Maximal Extractable Value (MEV) among validators and avoid validator centralization.

arxiv-2409-02287.title: Silicon Nitride Photonic Waveguide-Based Young’s Interferometer for Molecular Sensing Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2409-02287.creator: Sahar Delfan, 1,2 Mohit Khurana, 1,2,* Zhenhuan Yi, 1,2 Alexei Sokolov, 1,2 Aleksei M. Zheltikov, 1,2 and Marlan O. Scully 1,2,3,4
arxiv-2409-02287.description: Abstract Devices based on photonic integrated circuits play a crucial role in the development of low-cost, high-performance, industry-scale manufacturable sensors. We report the design, fabrication, and application of a silicon nitride waveguide-based integrated photonic sensor in Young’s interferometer configuration combined with Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor (CMOS) imaging detection.

arxiv-2412-13173.title: Locate n’ Rotate: Two-stage Openable Part Detection with Foundation Model Priors
arxiv-2412-13173.creator: Siqi Li, Xiaoxue Chen, Haoyu Cheng, Guyue Zhou, Hao Zhao, Guanzhong Tian✉
arxiv-2412-13173.description: Abstract Detecting the openable parts of articulated objects is crucial for downstream applications in intelligent robotics, such as pulling a drawer. This task poses a multitasking challenge due to the necessity of understanding object categories and motion. Most existing methods are either category-specific or trained on specific datasets, lacking generalization to unseen environments and objects.

arxiv-2501-11581.title: Open Sourcing GPTs: Economics of Open Sourcing Advanced AI Models Thanks: I wish to express my sincere gratitude to my advisors: Francesco Decarolis, Avi Goldfarb, Andrea Fosfuri, and Carlo Schwarz. I am also grateful to Kevin Bryan, Alfonso Gambardella, Joshua Gans, and Claudio Panico whose suggest
arxiv-2501-11581.creator: Mahyar Habibi Department of Economics, Bocconi University
arxiv-2501-11581.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mahyar Habibi Department of Economics, Bocconi University. This paper explores the economic underpinnings of open sourcing advanced large language models (LLMs) by for-profit companies. Empirical analysis reveals that: (1) LLMs are compatible with R&D portfolios of numerous technologically differentiated firms; (2) open-sourcing likelihood decreases with an LLM’s performance edge over rivals, but increases for models from large tech companies; and (3) open-sourcing an advanced LLM led to an increase in research-related activities.

arxiv-2506-04038.title: Generating Automotive Code: Large Language Models for Software Development and Verification in Safety-Critical Systems Thanks: 1 Technical University of Munich, Garching, Bayern, Germany Thanks: Thanks: This research was funded by the Federal Ministry of Education and Research of Germany (BMBF) as p
arxiv-2506-04038.creator: Sven Kirchner, Alois C. Knoll
arxiv-2506-04038.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sven Kirchner, Alois C. Knoll. Developing safety-critical automotive software presents significant challenges due to increasing system complexity and strict regulatory demands. This paper proposes a novel framework integrating Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) into the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). The framework uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate code generation in languages such as C++, incorporating safety-focused practices such as static verification, test-driven development and iterative refinement. A feedback-driven pipeline ensures the integration of test, simulation and verification for compliance with safety standards.

pmc-10619073.title: Youth partnership in suicide prevention research: moving beyond the safety discourse
pmc-10619073.creator: Maria Michail, Jamie Morgan, Anna Lavis
pmc-10619073.description: ObjectiveIn this communication article, we discuss coproduction in suicide prevention research, with an emphasis on involving young people. We critically reflect on the lessons we have learned by working alongside young people, and how these lessons may be useful to other research teams.

pmc-11421860.title: A novel stress sensor enables accurate estimation of micro-scale tissue mechanics in quantitative micro-elastography
pmc-11421860.creator: Kai L. Metzner, Qi Fang, Rowan W. Sanderson, Yen L. Yeow, Celia Green, Farah Abdul-Aziz, Juliana Hamzah, Alireza Mowla, Brendan F. Kennedy
pmc-11421860.description: Quantitative micro-elastography (QME) is a compression-based optical coherence elastography technique enabling the estimation of tissue mechanical properties on the micro-scale. QME utilizes a compliant layer as an optical stress sensor, placed between an imaging window and tissue, providing quantitative estimation of elasticity.

pmc-12529811.title: Distal chevron osteotomies enhance patient-reported outcomes for all severity grades of hallux valgus: a cohort study
pmc-12529811.creator: Cyrus D BRODÉN, Ann-Charlott SÖDERPALM, Eva TENGMAN, Nils P HAILER, Maria C CÖSTER
pmc-12529811.description: Background and purposeThere is limited data on the functional outcome after hallux valgus (HV) surgery. Our study aims to assess 1-year postoperative patient-reported outcomes (PROMs) after a chevron osteotomy (CO) for 3 severity levels, the number of additional surgical interventions during the index procedure, and the association between the presence or absence of internal fixation and PROMs.

pmc-13111101.title: Case Report: Complete remission after radiotherapy in two cases of locally advanced extramammary Paget’s disease of the perineum
pmc-13111101.creator: Hui Ma, Xiaohui Xie, Xiaodong Peng
pmc-13111101.description: PurposeReports on the efficacy of radiotherapy for perineal extramammary Paget’s disease (EMPD) are limited. We present two cases of locally advanced perineal EMPD successfully treated with radiotherapy.MethodsA retrospective review was conducted on the clinical presentation, management, and outcomes of two patients with locally advanced, inoperable perineal EMPD who received radiotherapy at our hospital.
